verdict.rationale: Kintsugi runs some recurring work automatically: it says it 'files and remits on schedule' and keeps connected platforms 'in sync from then on' after a one-time authorization. These are vendor-managed recurring processes, though. Nothing shows a user defining their own schedules, cron-style jobs or custom recurring workflows via the app, API or SDKs. Missing for 10: user-configurable scheduling of jobs or workflows, an API or SDK for creating and managing schedules, documentation of schedule options (frequency, triggers), independent or hands-on corroboration.
